subject.title: Feature: durable natural-language rule learning + explicit multi-mention reply semantics

question: Should OpenClaw introduce a first-class durable conversational rule-governance layer and a cross-channel contract that all explicitly mentioned bots reply once?
rationale: The request crosses memory authority, persisted state shape, workspace file precedence, and channel delivery semantics, and current main has useful pieces but no settled product contract for the proposed layer.

options.title: Keep as design tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open for a maintainer-sponsored design that defines rule authority, storage, conflict precedence, and multi-mention delivery before implementation.

options.title: Split narrower channel work
options.body: Handle Feishu self-mention and app-scoped ID message loss in focused channel issues while postponing durable rule learning.

options.title: Route to plugin/API design
options.body: Require the durable rule-learning capability to prove it cannot be built through memory/plugin APIs before adding new core rule-layer surface.

recommendation.title: Keep as design tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for a maintainer-sponsored design that defines rule authority, storage, conflict precedence, and multi-mention delivery before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the broadest recent history across the Feishu boundary, memory docs, and prompt/context surfaces implicated by this product decision.
